name: DynamicMusicBG
tagline: 根据当前音乐封面，在锁屏正在播放控件后方生成流动的动态色彩背景。
description: 动态音乐锁屏背景会根据完整音乐封面生成更匹配的配色，并在锁屏正在播放控件后方呈现平滑流动的动态背景。
切换歌曲时颜色自然过渡；暂停播放、开启减弱动态效果或屏幕进入暗显状态时，动画会自动暂停。
控制 Apple TV 等远程播放设备时，也会根据当前远程封面与播放状态更新背景。
features: 根据完整音乐封面自动生成更匹配的动态色彩背景
经典流动、氛围流动和轻柔流动三种多层动画效果
切换歌曲时通过 0.8 秒渐变过渡至新封面配色
支持 Apple TV 等远程播放设备的封面与播放状态
播放暂停、减弱动态效果及屏幕暗显时自动暂停动画
支持调节背景不透明度，并可与空间场景和趣味壁纸同时使用
设置修改立即生效，并支持 English、简体中文和繁體中文
usage: 安装后打开“设置”中的动态音乐锁屏背景并启用插件。
选择经典流动、氛围流动或轻柔流动效果。
如需显示更多下方壁纸，可在外观设置中降低背景不透明度。
播放带有有效封面的音乐并进入锁屏；正在播放控件出现时，动态背景会自动显示。

changes: 新增完整封面驱动的多层动态背景，配色与流动效果更加自然。
新增切歌 0.8 秒平滑渐变，避免背景闪烁或瞬间消失。
修复 Apple TV 远程切歌后配色不更新，并优化三种动画效果。
新增远程播放设备封面与播放状态支持，控制 Apple TV 时配色会跟随当前远程内容。
新增背景不透明度调节，可展示更多下方的空间场景或趣味壁纸。
修复锁屏时间、通知和正在播放控件可能被背景遮挡或无法交互的问题，并增强通知中心跟随稳定性。
新增根据音乐封面生成锁屏动态色彩背景，并提供三种动画效果。
新增切歌配色平滑过渡，以及播放暂停、减弱动态效果和屏幕暗显联动。
增强与空间场景、趣味壁纸同时使用时的显示兼容性。

en.name: DynamicMusicBG
en.tagline: Create a flowing album-art-driven color background behind Lock Screen Now Playing.
description: DynamicMusicBG uses the complete album artwork to create a better-matched palette and a smoothly animated background behind Lock Screen Now Playing.
Colors transition naturally when tracks change, while motion pauses automatically when playback pauses, Reduce Motion is enabled, or the display enters its dim state.
When controlling an Apple TV or another remote playback device, the background also follows the visible remote artwork and playback state.
features: Generate a better-matched animated color background from the complete album artwork
Multi-layer Legacy, Ambient, and Subtle animation styles
Transition to new artwork colors with a smooth 0.8-second crossfade
Artwork and playback-state support for Apple TV and other remote playback devices
Pause motion automatically with playback, Reduce Motion, and display dimming
Adjust background opacity and coexist with SpatialScene and Lenticular Wallpaper
Apply Settings changes immediately with English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese support
usage: Open DynamicMusicBG in Settings after installation and enable the tweak.
Choose the Legacy, Ambient, or Subtle animation style.
Lower Background Opacity in Appearance to reveal more of the wallpaper underneath.
Play music with valid artwork and open the Lock Screen; the animated background appears automatically with Now Playing.

changes: Added a complete-artwork-driven multi-layer background with more natural colors and motion.
Added a smooth 0.8-second track-change crossfade to prevent flashes or disappearing backgrounds.
Fixed stale colors after Apple TV track changes and refined all three animation styles.
Added remote artwork and playback-state support so colors follow the current Apple TV content while controlling it.
Added background opacity control to reveal more of SpatialScene or Lenticular Wallpaper underneath.
Fixed the background covering or blocking the clock, notifications, or Now Playing controls, and improved Notification Center movement stability.
Added album-art-driven animated Lock Screen colors with three animation styles.
Added smooth track-change transitions and motion control for playback, Reduce Motion, and display dimming.
Improved display compatibility when used with SpatialScene and Lenticular Wallpaper.
